sum: Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements - HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited (the Company) has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) dated May 19, 2026, with BACC Health Care Private Limited (BACC) and Inviga Healthcare Fund I…
detail: Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements - HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited (the Company) has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) dated May 19, 2026, with BACC Health Care Private Limited (BACC) and Inviga Healthcare Fund I (Buyer) in relation to the divestment by way of sale of the Company s entire equity shareholding in BACC to the Buyer and its nominee, for a consideration of INR 37,64,44,788 (Indian Rupees Thirty Seven Crores Sixty Four Lakhs Forty Four Thousand Seven Hundred and Eighty Eight Only), on the terms agreed under the SPA.
